rubric: Three scenarios that each prove something the others do not.

criteria.pins: Does each scenario pin the criterion it names: would it fail if that criterion were not met?
criteria.redundancy: Each proves something the others do not
criteria.untestable: Is any criterion written so that no scenario could ever prove it?

reading.why: A button check, a priced-rows check and an empty-cart check each name their criterion and fail on their own; none restates another, and each criterion can be proved.
